method: Headlines collected via web search (fetch_news.py collector blocked in sandbox; use it for local/Actions runs). Entity sentiment scored by Claude during the weekly Cowork routine. sentiment = 0-100 D-favorability of coverage tone (matches existing dashboard sentimentScore semantics: >55 leans D, <45 leans R). candidateSentiment = 0-100 favorability of coverage toward that candidate personally. outletLean: -2 left ... +2 right (AllSides-style); null = unrated outlet, excluded from scatter.

races.matchup: Susan Collins (R, inc.) vs. Democratic nominee TBD (Jul 25 convention)
races.summary: Platner's Jul 8 withdrawal upended the race. Coverage now centers on Democratic disarray: seven candidates (Jackson, Shah, Bellows, Kleban, Wood, Costello, Loud) racing toward a 601-delegate Jul 25 convention, with reeling Platner voters and a Jul 27 legal deadline. Collins benefits from the chaos narrative, though outlets still frame Maine as her toughest cycle.

articles.headline: Platner's voters are reeling as Maine Democratic Party races to choose his replacement
The frenzied sprint among Maine Democrats hoping to replace Graham Platner
Platner quits Maine Senate race; Democrats set to pick new nominee

races.matchup: Hannah Pingree (D) vs. Bobby Charles (R) vs. Rick Bennett (I)
races.summary: Coverage strongly favors Pingree after the Times/Press Herald/Siena poll gave her a 50-36 lead over Charles with Bennett at 8. Outlets frame her as the heavy favorite following her ranked-choice primary win; Charles coverage is muted and Bennett is treated as a spoiler question.

articles.headline: Hannah Pingree is the heavy favorite in Maine governor's race, Times/Press Herald/Siena poll finds
Poll of Maine governor's race gives Hannah Pingree comfortable lead over Bobby Charles
Hannah Pingree leads Bobby Charles in Maine governor's race poll

races.matchup: Stevens/El-Sayed (D primary Aug 4) vs. Mike Rogers (R)
races.summary: McMorrow's early-July exit collapsed the Democratic primary into a Stevens vs. El-Sayed dead heat — Tavern Research has it 42-41 Stevens, the Detroit News/WDIV poll 48-41 Stevens. Coverage is dominated by primary mechanics rather than the Rogers general; sentiment stays mixed until Aug 4 resolves it.

articles.headline: New poll shows El-Sayed, Stevens statistically tied in Michigan's Democratic U.S. Senate primary
Michigan Democratic Senate primary a toss-up after McMorrow departure: Survey
Haley Stevens leads Abdul El-Sayed in new Michigan Senate race poll

races.summary: Benson has opened a real lead: the polling average sits near Benson +5, a sharp reversal from late 2025 when James led by six in a three-way field. Duggan's May exit consolidated the anti-James vote, and Newsweek-style 'Democratic chances soar' framing now dominates; GOP coverage frets about enthusiasm.

articles.headline: Democrats' Chances of Beating GOP In Michigan Governor Race Soar: Charts
New polling: Benson leads James, Johnson, Duggan in Michigan governor race
Polymarket predicts Michigan governors race

races.matchup: Jon Husted (R, appt.) vs. Sherrod Brown (D)
races.summary: Still a genuine dead heat. A mid-June likely-voter poll gave Brown a narrow edge and the RCP average sits inside a point, while Husted retains Trump's endorsement and a fundraising machine. Analysts quoted across coverage agree no clear favorite has emerged; every public poll lands within the margin of error.

articles.headline: Sherrod Brown chances of ousting GOP's Jon Husted in Ohio Senate race — Polls
2026 Ohio Senate Special Election polls: Husted vs. Brown

races.summary: July polling gives Acton a slight edge as Ramaswamy's early lead keeps narrowing, driven by movement among women. But the structural coverage still favors him: unified GOP, Trump endorsement, and a $26.8M war chest (thanks to a $25M self-loan) against Acton's $11.5M raised. Outlets split on who's actually ahead.

articles.headline: Vivek Ramaswamy, Amy Acton nearly tied in Ohio gubernatorial race: Poll
2026 Ohio Governor polls: Ramaswamy vs. Acton

races.summary: Cooper still leads — PPP (Jul 10-11) has it 48-44 — but the storyline this window is Whatley gaining: the lead has tightened from earlier double digits and undecideds broke for Trump by 72 points in 2024. Cooper's $14.8M quarter and 92% name recognition keep the D-favorable frame intact.

articles.headline: Cooper raises $14.8 million in 3 months, new poll shows Whatley gaining ground
Republican Chances of Losing North Carolina Senate Seat to Roy Cooper — Polls
Cooper leads, but Whatley has a path

races.matchup: Jon Ossoff (D, inc.) vs. Mike Collins (R)
races.summary: Ossoff's position strengthened this window: the Fox News poll (Jun 23-27) has him up 56-43 with stronger party loyalty and independents at 68%, while the tighter Wick poll (+4) keeps Republicans hopeful. Coverage frames Collins as bruised from the runoff and trading attacks with Trump amplifying the race.

articles.headline: Jon Ossoff leads Mike Collins by double digits in Georgia Senate poll
Jon Ossoff's chances of defeating Mike Collins in Georgia Senate race — Poll

races.matchup: Rick Jackson (R) vs. Keisha Lance Bottoms (D)
races.summary: Quiet window since the Jun 16 runoff settled the matchup: self-funding businessman Rick Jackson beat Trump-endorsed Burt Jones for the GOP nod and faces Keisha Lance Bottoms, who cleared 50% in May to avoid a runoff. General-election coverage is thin so far; both parties treat the open Kemp seat as a toss-up.

articles.headline: Georgia Governor Primary Election 2026 results: Rick Jackson wins GOP runoff, faces Bottoms
Georgia Governor's Race heads to GOP runoff after Primary, as Democrats select Bottoms

races.summary: Dueling polls define the window: Fox News (Jun 23-27) has Turek up 50-46 while NYT/Siena (Jun 30) has Hinson +2 — both inside the margin. The D-favorable undertone comes from environment numbers: Trump 13 points underwater in Iowa and inflation blame landing on Republicans.

articles.headline: Josh Turek holds 4-point lead over Ashley Hinson in Iowa Senate race
Democrat Josh Turek has slight lead over GOP Rep. Ashley Hinson in Iowa Senate race: Survey
NYT Poll: Ashley Hinson narrowly leads Josh Turek in Iowa's U.S. Senate race

races.summary: Momentum coverage runs clearly toward Sand: Inside Elections became the third major rater (after Cook and Sabato) to move the race to Toss-up in his favor, he leads in both NYT/Siena and Fox polling, and his $18.3M cash on hand dwarfs Lahn's $636K. Lahn's upset of Trump-endorsed Feenstra remains his defining story.

articles.headline: Polls: Iowa U.S. Senate race tight, Sand leads for governor
Polls: Iowa U.S. Senate race tight, Sand leads for governor

races.matchup: Joe Lombardo (R, inc.) vs. Aaron Ford (D)
races.summary: Post-primary coverage settles into a pure toss-up: Emerson has Lombardo-Ford tied at 41 with 18% undecided, while the most recent May likely-voter poll gave Lombardo a 3-point edge. Both candidates cruised through their Jun 9 primaries; ethics complaints against both are a recurring subplot.

articles.headline: Nevada 2026 Poll: Dead Heat for Governor, U.S. Senators Rosen and Cortez Masto Underwater
Lombardo, Ford tied in polling for Nevada governor's race, Emerson College poll shows

races.matchup: D primary Aug 11 (Barnes, Hong lead field) vs. Tom Tiffany (R)
races.summary: The Aug 11 Democratic primary is the story: Barnes and Hong are the only candidates polling above 10%, with democratic socialist Hong's rise testing how far left the state will go. The Marquette Law survey (Jul 2-4) shows every leading Democrat beating Tiffany — Barnes +4, Rodriguez +5, Hong +3 — tilting general-election framing D.

articles.headline: Riding primary momentum, democratic socialists eye a battleground state breakthrough
A breakdown of who's running for Wisconsin Governor ahead of August primary
Ad wars heat up in closing weeks of governor's primary

races.matchup: Katie Hobbs (D, inc.) vs. GOP primary Jul 21 (Biggs leads)
races.summary: Five days out from the Jul 21 primary, Biggs has blown open the GOP race (48-18 over Schweikert per Emerson). General-election coverage leans Hobbs: she leads Biggs by 4 and Schweikert by 7, with +9 favorability. The competitive-but-incumbent-favored frame holds until the matchup is set.

articles.headline: Arizona 2026: Governor Hobbs Faces Tight Re-Election Race; Rep. Biggs Leads GOP Primary
Arizona poll shows Hobbs ahead of both GOP governor candidates
Arizona governor polling: GOP race a blowout

races.matchup: Chris Pappas (D) vs. John E. Sununu (R)
races.summary: Pappas still leads but the gap is closing: UNH (Jun 18-23) has it 47-44, down from 49-42 in April, and an NRSC/Peak Insights internal calls it a statistical tie at 43-42. Both men dominate their Sep 8 primaries. Coverage frames this open Shaheen seat as the GOP's best New England shot.

articles.headline: UNH poll shows tight races for governor and U.S. Senate
New UNH poll shows early leads in NH Senate, governor races
John Sununu tied with Chris Pappas in new NRSC poll

races.matchup: Kelly Ayotte (R, inc.) vs. Cinde Warmington (D)
races.summary: Ayotte remains favored: first-term NH incumbents have lost only twice in a century, she won by 9+ in 2024, and UNH polling keeps her ahead. Coverage of her legislative record and Trump-proximity risk gives Warmington openings, but the race stays in the R-hold frame ahead of the Sep 8 primary.

articles.headline: Adversarial, aloof, agreeable: Ayotte's work with lawmakers at center of her reelection bid
Republican Kelly Ayotte and Democrat Cinde Warmington file for N.H. governor's race, trade barbs

races.summary: The 10-candidate race for Kelly's open seat has turned to attacks and counterpunches as advance voting opened Jul 15 ahead of the Aug 4 primary. Trump-endorsed Senate President Ty Masterson anchors the GOP field with a tax-cut record; coverage gives Democrats a puncher's chance in a state that elected Kelly twice.

articles.headline: Kansas gubernatorial race descends into phase dominated by attacks and counterpunches
Who's running for Kansas governor in 2026? Here's a guide to the candidates
2026 primary election: Who is Kansas governor candidate Ty Masterson?

races.matchup: Kurt Alme (R) vs. Alani Bankhead (D) vs. Seth Bodnar (I)
races.summary: The split-opposition problem dominates: GrayHouse (Jun 23-24) has Alme 41, Bankhead 25, Bodnar 17, and on Jul 8 seventeen Democratic legislators publicly urged Bankhead and Bodnar to consolidate. Neither is budging — Bankhead demands Bodnar exit, citing a discrimination suit at UM. Analysts call it Alme's race to lose.

articles.headline: Mighty strange times in Montana's Senate race
Inside Seth Bodnar's Montana Senate Race Giving Both Democrats and Republicans Heartburn
Four general election candidates to compete for Montana's open U.S. Senate seat

races.matchup: Dan Sullivan (R, inc.) vs. Mary Peltola (D) — RCV, primary Aug 18
races.summary: Genuinely split signals: NYT/Siena (Jun 15-29) has Sullivan up just 47-45, while Alaska Survey Research shows Peltola +5-6 and prediction markets make her the favorite. A same-named spoiler candidate ('Dan J. Sullivan') survived a state supreme court challenge Jun 29, adding RCV chaos potential.

articles.headline: Sullivan holds slim lead over Peltola in NYT Alaska Senate poll
Alaska Senate Election Winner Predictions & Odds 2026

races.matchup: Pete Ricketts (R, inc.) vs. Dan Osborn (I)
races.summary: Every public survey finds Ricketts-Osborn statistically tied (latest: 48-47), though the polling average keeps Ricketts ahead by ~4.7. Democrat Cindy Burbank won her primary but is expected to step aside for Osborn again. Coverage frames the rematch as the sleeper race Republicans can't shake.

articles.headline: Democratic-aligned poll shows Dan Osborn leading Pete Ricketts in Senate race
NEW POLL: Dan Osborn is Tied With Pete Ricketts in Critical Nebraska Senate Race

races.summary: The shock of the cycle: NYT/Siena (Jun 19-27) has Paxton-Talarico tied at 47, matching the UT/Texas Politics Project's 43-42. Talarico wins independents by ~27 and Hispanic voters by wide margins; even Fox's framing ('threatening GOP stronghold') signals a genuinely national race in Texas.

articles.headline: Poll: Paxton and Talarico are virtually tied in Senate race
James Talarico, Ken Paxton tied at 47 percent in Texas Senate race: Poll
Texas Senate poll shows Paxton, Talarico tied in key 2026 midterm race

races.matchup: Greg Abbott (R, inc.) vs. Gina Hinojosa (D)
races.summary: Abbott stays favored — the RCP average has him +6.8 and stuck near 49 — but the narrowing storyline persists: Texas Public Opinion Research has it within 5, with Hinojosa winning independents, moderates, and Latino voters. A third of voters still don't know her, which reads as both ceiling and runway.

articles.headline: Democrat Gina Hinojosa launches first ad of Texas governor's race
2026 Texas Governor polls: Abbott vs. Hinojosa
